newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shrs end down, profit-taking bleeds mid-caps.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shrs end down, profit-taking bleeds mid-caps.

text.p: The composite stock index ended Friday's trading lower due to profit-taking in small and mid-cap shares, brokers said.

The index fell 9.48 points to close provisionally at 830.25. Declining shares eclipsed advancers 812 to 136, while 349 hit their lower limit. Trading was active with 44.57 million shares changing hands.
"Reports that the exchange was investigating stock manipulation convinced a lot of investors to take cash in smaller shares that had sharply risen recently," said Park Hae-soo of Seoul Securities.
